function: PPO jointly controls aerial STAR-RIS amplitudes and phase shifts, IoT transmit power, UAV trajectory and task-offloading portion to minimize total energy consumption (pp. 1, 4).
system: UAV-carried energy-splitting STAR-RIS (6 to 14 elements), multi-antenna BS, 6 IoT devices, no direct link, 100 m x 100 m area; frequency band not stated (pp. 2, 4-5).
method: PPO actor-critic reinforcement learning; reward is energy plus penalties for constraint violations; trained by interacting with the simulated environment; network sizes and hyperparameters not given (p. 4).
data_channel: Custom simulation: Rician links (factor 10), i.i.d. complex Gaussian NLoS, 100 m x 100 m area; no standard model, dataset or measurements (pp. 3-5).
test_conditions: No separate training and test conditions stated; one 6-device scenario, results swept over input data size (30 to 150 Mbits) and elements (6 to 14) (p. 5).
baselines: Fixed trajectory with predefined values (non-learned); conventional RIS with PPO (variant of the proposed system); full offloading, lambda=1 (learning not stated); no other learned method (p. 5).
metrics: Total energy consumption in joules (local computation, offloading transmission, flight) versus input data size and number of RIS elements; UAV trajectories compared (p. 5, Fig. 2).
complexity: none; no complexity order, operation count, parameter count or runtime is given (pp. 1-5).
openness: none; no code, data or link is mentioned (pp. 1-5).
q1_support: p. 3: "We assume the Rician channel model" - custom Rician simulator (factor 10, i.i.d. Gaussian NLoS, p. 5); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 5: "Performance comparison of total energy consumption under different input data size" - Fig. 2 caption: sweeps over data size and number of elements; the paper never says a trained policy is tested on conditions unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 5: "conventional RIS, where the RIS is replaced with STAR-RIS and execute PPO to solve the problem" - the fixed trajectory is non-learned, but the only learned comparison is the same PPO on a conventional RIS (a variant); no earlier learned method or other DRL algorithm.
q4_support: p. 4: "The overall algorithm is explained in Algorithm 1." - only the algorithm is listed; no complexity order, operations, parameters or runtime appear anywhere in pp. 1-5.
q5_support: p. 4: "we evaluate our proposed system to determine its effectiveness through numerical results" - own simulated setup (pp. 4-5); the paper mentions no code, data release or link.
notes: Read in full from the PDF text (pp. 1-5) and the figure page (p. 5). The PDF is the arXiv:2312.08714v1 preprint 'Aerial STAR-RIS Empowered MEC: A DRL Approach for Energy Minimization' (p. 1); it prints no DOI. Included because PPO learns physical-layer decisions (STAR-RIS amplitudes and phases, transmit power) jointly with offloading and trajectory, which passes above_phy. Area 6 chosen over 3 by the specificity order, since the RIS is UAV-borne and transmit power is learned; area 3 also fits, reviewer to confirm. q3: the conventional-RIS baseline runs the same PPO and is treated as a variant of the proposed method; reviewer to confirm.
